definition.label: Sculpt a surface path
definition.description: Raise, lower or level a configured surface along one swept local X/Z path. radius is in local metres; height is the maximum raise/lower amount or the target level. Smooth falloff reaches zero at the brush rim. Every grid vertex is affected at most once by the union of the path, so duplicate points or self-crossings do not multiply strength. Values clamp to 0..maxHeight. All path points must be inside the configured rectangle. A sub-grid brush can miss every vertex and is refused without saving. One action is one saved edit and one Undo, with the same rebuilt mesh/collision. Authoring can add/remove geometric volume; it is not conserved snow transfer. Current revision and exclusive object ownership are required. No playback, physics start or delayed repetition is implied.
